evals.prompt: Create an issue titled 'Login redirect fails on Safari' in owner/repo.
evals.expected_output: Runs get_me, searches for duplicates, then creates the issue.
expectations: Runs get_me first to confirm identity
Searches for duplicate issues before creating
Creates the issue with the supplied title

evals.expected_output: Runs the 3-step PR review workflow on the pull request.
expectations: Uses minimal_output when details aren't needed

evals.expected_output: Merges the PR via the GitHub API.
expectations: Uses the merge tool scoped to the authenticated user

evals.prompt: Search the GitHub codebase for references to DEPRECATED_API.
evals.expected_output: Runs code search across the org/repo for the query.
expectations: Returns paginated results (5-10 per page recommended)
Respects minimal_output when details aren't needed

evals.prompt: List the latest releases of owner/repo.
evals.expected_output: Lists releases, including latest and get-by-tag where requested.

evals.prompt: Scan this diff for leaked credentials before I commit.
evals.expected_output: Runs secret scanning against the diff and flags any credentials/API keys/tokens.
expectations: Proactively scans diff/file contents for credentials

evals.expected_output: Requests Copilot review on the PR, with manual fallback if unavailable.
expectations: Invokes Copilot review via the API
Surfaces the error and suggests manual review if unavailable

evals.prompt: Who am I authenticated as on GitHub?
evals.expected_output: Runs get_me and returns the authenticated user.
expectations: Used as the safety-first prelude to other operations

evals.prompt: I hit a rate limit listing issues — what now?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces rate limit info and suggests waiting or reducing perPage.

evals.prompt: Update the README in owner/repo with this new content.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the file (gets SHA), then updates via the file CRUD tool.
expectations: Calls get_file_contents first to retrieve the SHA
Errors instructing to fetch SHA first if missing
Updates the file via the GitHub API, not local filesystem
